about:
Nordic Foods, Inc. was conceived and opened in 1980 in Kansas City, Kansas, by three principals with deep experience in the meat industry. The business is now owned and operated by the second generation — Ted Jovanovic and Jason Hall, sons of the remaining two principals — who have reshaped the company to meet evolving market demands.

The company operates a 47,000-square-foot facility, its third location, designed for its unique manufacturing requirements. Nordic Foods produces a range of meat products including raw, solid, chopped and formed, breaded and unbreaded items. Its capabilities span meat processing, co-packing, and wholesale meats, with product lines such as solid muscle cuts, breaded beef steaks, liver portions, and seasoned beef blends with onions, peppers, and proprietary sauces.

Nordic Foods primarily serves institutional customers and food service distributors nationwide. It assists clients in developing products with specific characteristics, often under private label or proprietary formulations, shipping to distributors across the country.

The company states its goal is to manufacture safe, quality food products in sufficient quantities to continuously satisfy customers while supporting employees and families. It emphasizes high sanitation, rigorous quality and production controls, and the delivery of consistent, reasonably priced products in a timely manner.
